SessionStep helper: one scoped attempt invocation
|
|-- Attempt-owned state
|   |-- pendingStartSnapshot fiber -> Snapshot.capture (overlaps request)
|   |-- Event publisher (createLLMEventPublisher)
|   |   |-- StepRecord: output, failure, finish/usage, continuation facts
|   |   |-- Tool-state map + text/reasoning/tool-input fragment buffers
|   |   |   `-- Ordinals and batched deltas; flush at stream boundaries
|   |   `-- -> Bus: content/tool/step events -> shared projections/live feed
|   `-- toolRuns[] (local calls only)
|       `-- Each run: ToolCall + execution fiber + cancel gate
|-- Provider stream consumer -> LLMClient.stream(prepared request/options)
|   |-- Consume through stream end, not merely the finish event
|   |-- Await start snapshot before first publication
|   |-- Publish Tool.Called before forking local tool execution
|   |   `-- Tool fiber
|   |       |-- prepared.executeTool -> selected Tool snapshot.execute
|   |       |   `-- Registry hooks + permissions; declines remain control failures
|   |       `-- ToolOutput.truncate -> publisher -> next-step history
|   `-- Provider-hosted results -> publisher; no local execution fiber
`-- Settlement (final durable publications are uninterruptible)
    |-- Flush publisher; mark stream complete; await all tool exits
    |-- stopTools on interruption
    |   |-- User stop -> signal listening cancel gates; interrupt other tools
    |   `-- Wait up to 5 seconds, then interrupt remaining tools
    |-- Daemon handoff interruption (not user stop, no declines)
    |   `-- Leave calls and step unsettled for restart recovery
    |-- Before visible output -> overflow callback / transport recovery
    |-- Classify failures, declines and missing/incomplete tool results
    |-- End snapshot -> file changes; usage -> tokens/cost
    |   `-- Publish Step.Ended / Step.Failed after tool settlement
    `-- Return Outcome or fail/interrupt -> runner owns next-step policy
